old_problem: Fatal wording conflicts with a correctable high-temperature warning; railtype8 and voltage parameters, sensor/I2C target matrix, threshold/hysteresis, event count, no-reset/no-shutdown oracle and clear/deassert recovery are unauthoritative.
disposition_reason: The warning/critical boundary and deassert behavior are core thermal safety and verdict semantics, not runtime parameters. ED-12/15/16/18 require authoritative thresholds, no-real-heating safeguards and recovery, so this remains Pending/BLOCKED.
decision_basis: Read row96/history2494 and distinguished this warning from row93 critical shutdown and row97 voltage PowerGood.
Preserved every DIMM, railtype8, both disputed voltage types, fatal label, correctable criterion and OS evidence.
Required one synthetic assert, zero critical action, safe actual temperatures and documented deassertion.
Required sensor-address topology, fan health and memory recovery for each target.
No heating, injection, clear, reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Synthetic DDR5 PMIC high-temperature warning assert/deassert
test_case.purpose: For every mapped PMIC temperature sensor, inject one approved synthetic high-warning transition, prove exactly one correctable warning without critical shutdown/reset or real heating, then verify documented deassertion and continued fan/memory health.
required_package: Vendor railtype8 and parameter applicability definition
Warning and critical thresholds, hysteresis, latch/status/clear semantics
Per-DIMM PMIC sensor/address and Wistron BMC I2C/OOB map
Approved warning severity and explicit no-reset/no-shutdown policy
Exact tuple matrix, event fields, physical-temperature limits and restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: Do not execute the source tuple or heat hardware. After approval, capture actual sensor/ambient temperatures, fans, warning/critical status and memory; inject one mapped synthetic warning once; record the target assertion and absence of critical action; perform the approved deassert/clear and restore settings before another sensor.
test_case.expected_result: The intended sensor asserts exactly the approved warning while actual temperatures stay safe, critical status and power action remain absent, fresh correctable evidence is recorded, and after deassert all sensors, fans, DIMMs, memory and settings are healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative target/threshold identity, one fresh warning, zero critical/reset/shutdown evidence, safe physical temperatures and complete deassertion/restoration. Generic logs, real heating, stale status, wrong sensor, fan anomaly or memory error fails.
safety_gate: Synthetic stimulus only; never heat PMIC/DIMM.
Independent temperature, fan, power and OOB monitoring below critical margin.
One sensor once; no automatic clear or traversal.
Abort on actual rise, critical bit, power action, wrong sensor, I2C loss or DIMM error.
expected_evidence: Railtype8 warning/critical threshold and hysteresis authority
Exact tuple and timestamped single warning assertion
Fresh PMIC/CPER/SEL warning and zero critical/power delta
Approved deassert, normal sensors/fans, full DIMM and bounded memory evidence
test_case.recovery: Preserve status, then clear/deassert only by the approved PMIC procedure. Restore PMIC recovery, SPD control, telemetry, I2C and BIOS/HDT; verify normal sensors/fans and all memory. Keep the host safe/off if any real thermal or critical state appears.
